title: A low decal on a far surface z-fights (FLICKER 180 px)
summary: A road decal 2 cm above ground 30 m from the camera, made transparent with feathered edges, z-fought (FLICKER). Lift far decals 4.5-8 cm and keep a polygonOffset; depth precision falls with distance.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: road at y .045, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -2; dirt patch at y .08, factor -3

doc.when: Decals (roads, patches, stains) on surfaces far from the camera.
doc.avoid: Millimetre lifts at distance; transparency without offset.
gotchas: Transparent decals also sort: keep them few.

problem.symptom: FLICKER on a decal region; shimmer in motion.
problem.cause: Too little separation for the depth buffer's precision at that distance, plus transparency sorting.
problem.detect: The flicker check (re-render with the near plane changed).
